authority: OWNER-GRAPHITE-DEV-LEVELS-01 F1 (development-only variants: the Test Lead reviews; the construction contract owner decides only at LOCK)

changes: The pool is Carbon's published pool and it is dynamic: TRAIN plus PRACTICE plus every bank case that auto-retires and is published (OWNER-BANK-ARCHITECTURE-01).
The pool is versioned by its published-set digest; a recipe pins the pool version it selects from.
Disjoint from every hidden, tuning, confirmation, study and decision set, checked with the validator's overlap check.
The selected subset's size counts in the training budget cost calculator.
It duplicates Level 3's numerics.quasi_newton_family; polish numerics belong at Level 3.
Menu lbfgs, bfgs, ssbfgs, ssbroyden; default lbfgs.
Menu strong_wolfe, backtracking, none; 'none' is the miner's own risk, bounded by the step budget.
It duplicates Level 2's optimizer.muon_spectral; revisit after Level 2 data.

conditions: Reconstruction tests prove determinism (R1 on CPU), a loss decrease on a fixed battery checkpoint, and default equivalence: the default choice is byte-identical to today. A test never claims a paper's reported improvement; that is a science claim, not a build gate.
The training budget cost calculator counts each new routine's real cost (an SVD per step, full-memory BFGS), and Phase F of the budget study stress-tests them.
SVD and BFGS are flagged as GPU-nondeterminism risks for the A40 R1 leg.
Development-only variants live outside CONTRACTS; miner surfaces refuse them; findings block LOCK, not exploration.

guards.bfgs_memory: Full-memory BFGS is O(p^2): refused at compile when p^2 x dtype bytes exceeds the sheet's memory ceiling, or above a parameter threshold (HUMAN_INPUT, measured in Phase 0 / Phase F). A pre-run refusal, never an out-of-memory at rebuild.
guards.line_search_evaluations: Strong-Wolfe and backtracking make a variable number of loss evaluations per step: each routine has a fixed, recorded cap on evaluations per step, and the cost calculator counts the cap as the worst case.
guards.svd_cost: SpecMuon's per-step SVD is counted at the full matrix size in the cost calculator.
guards.candidate_fault: Divergence or NaN under line_search none or a quasi-Newton routine is a candidate fault (bounded rebuild, scored as failed) under the existing candidate-fault policy, never FAILED_INFRA, so diverging buys no free retry.
guards.gpu_determinism: SVD and BFGS options are refused on the scored GPU lane until the A40 R1 leg passes them; recorded CPU_ONLY_DEV until then.
guards.pool_integrity: Each pool version is immutable and digest-pinned, and old versions stay retrievable so old recipes reproduce; a refusal list withdraws a pool case found mis-solved from new versions; selection weights are capped or normalised so weighting cannot emulate repetition beyond the step budget.

guards_rule: Each guard ships with a mutation test (the Test Lead's attack review, 2026-10-07).
